what.text: This page follows refugees from Burkina Faso in all host countries combined.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 351209 refugees from Burkina Faso, and Mali hosts the largest share, 57.2%.
Côte d'Ivoire and Togo are the next largest hosts.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Burkina Faso with JNIM from 2018 to 2025, at war level from 2022.
It also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group from 2019 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's figure rose from 150081 at the end of 2024 to 351209 at the end of 2025, its highest.
The figure also changed sharply between 2017 and 2018 and in each year from 2022, in the same years as the conflicts UCDP records.

how.text: These are year-end totals of refugees; asylum seekers from Burkina Faso are counted in a separate series.
People displaced inside Burkina Faso are counted separately by UNHCR and by IDMC, and their figures are never added.
The sources don't say which routes people took.
